name: Cursor
description: Fork of VS Code engineered from the ground up for collaborative human-AI coding with multi-file contextual understanding, predictive edits, and terminal command intelligence.
longDescription: Cursor has redefined software engineering velocity. Built with custom frontier model fine-tunes and proprietary codebase indexing (shadow workspace indexing), Cursor understands your entire repository's dependency graph. Features include Copilot++ speculative multi-line edits, full codebase chat, terminal error auto-resolution, and instant diff rollbacks.
keyFeatures: Full codebase semantic indexing & search
Copilot++ predictive multi-line tab completions
Terminal auto-debug and automated fix generation
Custom system prompt rules & .cursorrules support
cons: Heavy RAM usage on massive monorepos
Requires active internet connection for index syncing

name: Midjourney v6.1
description: Industry benchmark generative imaging platform featuring state-of-the-art text coherence, micro-texture rendering, lighting precision, and cinematic composition controls.
longDescription: Midjourney v6.1 represents the pinnacle of visual generative models. It excels at intricate text rendering inside generated scenes, accurate body kinematics, realistic skin micro-textures, and granular camera parameters (aspect ratio, stylize parameters, weirdness factors, pan/zoom out).
keyFeatures: In-image typography and sign rendering
Vary Region (Inpainting) and Pan/Zoom Out
Style reference (--sref) & Character consistency (--cref)
Web interface generation suite with batch upscaling
pros: Incredible aesthetic intuition without long prompts

name: Perplexity AI
tagline: Conversational Answer Engine with Live Citations
description: Real-time AI search engine combining web indexing, multi-source citation verification, mathematical reasoning, and deep research synthesis.
longDescription: Perplexity replaces traditional search links with structured, synthesized answers backed by verified inline citations. Its 'Pro Search' performs multi-step reasoning, autonomously generating follow-up queries, scraping secondary sources, executing Python code for math and charts, and delivering comprehensive research dossiers.
keyFeatures: Live web citations with source snippet previews
Pro Search with multi-step query decomposition
Collections / Spaces for shared team research
Model switching (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Sonar)
pros: Halts hallucinations with direct source citations
cons: Pro query rate limits on base tier

name: Suno v3.5
description: Full-song audio synthesis creating complete multi-instrumental tracks with verse-chorus arrangements, studio vocal mixing, and genre cross-pollination.
longDescription: Suno can generate complete 2-to-4-minute songs across any musical genre from a simple text prompt. It models complex song structures (intros, verses, pre-choruses, hooks, guitar solos, and outros), delivering radio-ready vocal performances, harmonies, and realistic instrumentation.
keyFeatures: Custom lyrics & structural tag support [Verse], [Chorus]
Audio input continuation & cover generation
Multi-genre synthesis (Cyberpunk Synthwave, Jazz, Metal)
High-bitrate stem and master audio downloads
pros: Astonishing vocal emotion and genre fidelity
cons: Occasional compression artifacts in high frequencies

name: ElevenLabs
description: State-of-the-art voice generation platform with zero-shot voice cloning, emotional inflection controls, multilingual dubbing, and low-latency conversational APIs.
longDescription: ElevenLabs utilizes proprietary deep generative audio models that capture subtle vocal inflections, breathing nuances, pacing, and emotional weight. It is widely used in audiobooks, video localization, game development, and real-time voice agents.
keyFeatures: Instant zero-shot voice cloning from 1-minute audio
Automatic video translation & dubbing with lip-sync
Real-time Conversational Voice Agent WebSocket API
Custom sound effects (SFX) generation
pros: Support for 32+ languages with native accents
cons: Character credit limits deplete quickly on long files
Rigorous voice verification needed for security

name: v0 by Vercel
tagline: Generative UI System for Modern Web Applications
description: Natural language to production-grade React, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide Icon components with immediate interactive sandbox preview and direct CLI deployment.
longDescription: v0 enables designers and engineers to prompt complex frontend interfaces and receive clean, modular React component code formatted according to modern accessibility standards and design systems.
keyFeatures: Instant interactive iframe sandbox preview
Direct copy-to-clipboard or npx CLI installation
Figma design screenshot to code conversion
Support for Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui
cons: Complex custom state logic still requires manual refinement

name: Devin AI
description: Autonomous AI software engineering agent capable of managing entire development lifecycles: reading documentation, debugging builds, running test suites, and submitting GitHub PRs.
longDescription: Devin operates inside an isolated sandbox equipped with a terminal, browser, and code editor. Given a GitHub issue or feature request, Devin reasons through multiple steps, analyzes repository files, plans architecture changes, compiles code, tests unit suites, and resolves compiler errors.
keyFeatures: Autonomous sandbox with terminal, browser, and IDE
Self-directed API documentation reading & testing
Automatic unit testing and regression resolution
End-to-end pull request generation on GitHub
pros: Handles tedious package migrations and bug triage
cons: High compute cost per autonomous task

name: Runway Gen-3 Alpha
description: Frontier video generation model offering cinematic temporal consistency, dynamic camera motion paths, and realistic physical lighting simulations.
longDescription: Runway Gen-3 Alpha generates hyper-realistic video clips with expressive character motion, complex camera trajectories (pan, tilt, zoom, orbit), and detailed environmental physics.
keyFeatures: Text-to-Video & Image-to-Video generation
Motion Brush for localized area motion control
Advanced Director Mode for 3D camera paths
Lip sync and background soundtrack generation
pros: Cinematic fidelity with realistic motion blur
cons: Occasional morphological drift in complex limbs
